source: CIRCL CVE Search + GitHub Advisory OSV + CISA KEV + NIST NVD

cves.summary: Cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in index.cgi for Bandmin 1.4 allows remote attackers to insert arbitrary HTML or script via (1) the year parameter in a showmonth action, (2) the month parameter in a showmonth action, or (3) the host parameter in a showhost action.
Directory traversal vulnerability in Son hServer 0.2 allows remote attackers to read arbitrary files via ".|." (modified dot-dot) sequences.
WQuinn QuotaAdvisor 4.1 does not properly record file sizes if they are stored in alternative data streams, which allows users to bypass quota restrictions.

bctool in Jetico BestCrypt 0.7 and earlier trusts the user-supplied PATH to find and execute an fsck utility program, which allows local users to gain privileges by modifying the PATH to point to a Trojan horse program.
telnet95.exe in Pragma InterAccess 4.0 build 5 allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (crash) via a large number of characters to port 23, possibly due to a buffer overflow.

Volution clients 1.0.7 and earlier attempt to contact the computer creation daemon (CCD) when an LDAP authentication failure occurs, which allows remote attackers to fully control clients via a Trojan horse Volution server.
kmmodreg in HP-UX 11.11, 11.04 and 11.00 allows local users to create arbitrary world-writeable files via a symlink attack on the (1) /tmp/.kmmodreg_lock and (2) /tmp/kmpath.tmp temporary files.
makewhatis in the man package before 1.5i2 allows an attacker in group man to overwrite arbitrary files via a man page whose name contains shell metacharacters.
Bugzilla 2.14 before 2.14.2, and 2.16 before 2.16rc2, allows authenticated users with editing privileges to delete other users by directly calling the editusers.cgi script with the "del" option.

Cross-site scripting vulnerabilities in Bugzilla 2.14 before 2.14.2, and 2.16 before 2.16rc2, could allow remote attackers to execute script as other Bugzilla users via the full name (real name) field, which is not properly quoted by editusers.cgi.

Multiple buffer overflows in SLMail 5.1.0.4420 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via (1) a long EHLO argument to slmail.exe, (2) a long XTRN argument to slmail.exe, (3) a long string to POPPASSWD, or (4) a long password to the POP3 server.
Directory traversal vulnerability in emumail.cgi in EMU Webmail 4.5.x and 5.1.0 allows remote attackers to read arbitrary files or list arbitrary directories via a .. (dot dot) in the type parameter.

A vulnerability was identified in Skyvern-AI Skyvern 1.0.56. Impacted is the function classify_url of the file skyvern/forge/sdk/browser_egress_policy.py. The manipulation leads to server-side request forgery. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. Upgrading to version 1.0.57 is recommended to address this issue. The identifier of the patch is 10b8d829c2750ebf62f2b70dec0e288297e752dd. Upgrading the affected component is recommended.

A security vulnerability has been detected in itsourcecode Banking Management System 1.0. This issue affects some unknown processing of the file manage_handover.php. The manipulation of the argument ID leads to sql injection. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used.

A vulnerability was detected in liukuo362573 YiShaAdmin up to ba04d5072885447553e372bb87e372b55a90780c. Impacted is the function SqlServerPageSql/OraclePageSql/MySqlPageSql/ of the file YiSha.Data/YiSha.Data/Extension/DatabasePageExtension.cs of the component Pagination Sorting. The manipulation of the argument sort results in sql injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. This product takes the approach of rolling releases to provide continious delivery. Therefore, version details for affected and updated releases are not available. The patch is identified as 19b0bdffc9587bff291bac81586953277abe5b84. Applying a patch is advised to resolve this issue.

The Nexter Blocks Pro plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in all versions up to, and including, 5.0.10 via the `tpgb_ajax_register_user()` function. This is due to a byte-level denylist on the `tpgb_acf_key[]` and `tpgb_acf[]` parameters that fails to block Unicode look-alike characters — such as U+1E87 and U+00E7 in a key like `ẇp_çapabilities` — whose UTF-8 byte sequences do not match any ASCII-based pattern check, while the database's default accent-insensitive collation (`utf8mb4_unicode_ci` / `utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci`) treats the decorated key as equivalent to the canonical `wp_capabilities` row, causing `update_user_meta()` to overwrite the newly registered user's role with `administrator`. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to register a new account bearing the full Administrator role, gaining complete control over the WordPress site including the ability to install plugins, modify files, and execute arbitrary code. The nonce required by the handler is publicly emitted on any page containing the tp-login-register block, making the full exploit chain — nonce retrieval, a single crafted registration POST, and the plugin's own `autologin` flow — trivially reachable on any default install where user registration is enabled. Successful exploitation causes the attacker's own account to receive the complete Administrator role.

A weakness has been identified in Moonshot AI Kimi Code up to 2.7.2. This vulnerability affects the function guardToolExecution of the file packages/agent-core-v2/src/features/plan/planService.ts of the component Plan Mode Permission Guard. Executing a manipulation can lead to improper authorization. The attack requires local access. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.
